verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਤੋਲੁ ਨ ਤੋਲਣਿ ਤੋਲੀਐ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh pooraa tol na tolan toleeaai|

en.bdb: Gurmukh is perfect; he cannot be weighed on any scale.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਬੋਲ ਨ ਬੋਲਣਿ ਬੋਲੀਐ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh pooraa bol na bolan boleeaai|

en.bdb: Every word by gurmukh comes to be true and perfect and nothing can be said about him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਤਿ ਅਡੋਲ ਨ ਡੋਲਣਿ ਡੋਲੀਐ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh mat addol na ddolan ddoleeaai|

en.bdb: The wisdom of gurmukhs is stable one and does not get destabilised even if done so.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਿਰਮ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਨ ਮੋਲਣਿ ਮੋਲੀਐ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh piram amol na molan moleeaai|

en.bdb: The love of gurmukhs is invaluable and it cannot be purchased at any cost.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥ ਨਿਰੋਲੁ ਨ ਰੋਲਣਿ ਰੋਲੀਐ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh pa(n)th nirol na rolan roleeaai|

en.bdb: The way of gurmukh is clear and distinct; it cannot be subsumed and dissipated by any one.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਲੋਲੁ ਪੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਝੋਲੀਐ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sabadh alol pee a(n)mrit jholeeaai ||20||

en.bdb: The words of gurmukhs are steadfast; along with them one quaffs nectar by deleting passions and carnal desires.
